meta.notes: Seeded from the React components in frontend/components/. Verification requires the prototype to be runnable in a browser; current state is JSX source without a build pipeline, so all features will read as not-yet-verifiable until Vite/Webpack/similar is wired up.

features.description: Resident app renders main sections without errors
steps: Boot the prototype (cd backend && npm start, open http://localhost:3000/)
Navigate to the resident view (mounted from components/resident-app.jsx)
Verify the page header, navigation, and primary content area are visible
Verify the browser DevTools console reports zero errors

features.description: Council dashboard renders main sections without errors
steps: Boot the prototype
Navigate to the council view (mounted from components/council-dashboard.jsx)
Verify dashboard widgets (data summaries, controls) are visible
Verify the browser DevTools console reports zero errors

features.description: Design canvas can toggle between resident and council views
steps: Boot the prototype
Open the design canvas (components/design-canvas.jsx)
Toggle the active view between resident and council
Verify each toggle renders the corresponding component without errors

features.description: Browser-window frame chrome renders around active view
steps: Boot the prototype
Verify components/browser-window.jsx renders as a frame around the active view
Verify the frame's tab/URL elements display the expected labels
Boot the prototype
Open the tweaks panel (components/tweaks-panel.jsx)
Verify each control is interactive and updates the canvas state
Verify no console errors are emitted while interacting

features.description: Application loads without console errors or unhandled promise rejections
steps: Boot the prototype
Open browser DevTools Console tab
Reload the page
Verify zero errors and zero unhandled rejections appear in the console

features.description: Application emits structured log events for primary user actions
steps: Boot the prototype
Perform a representative user action (e.g., switch view, change a tweak)
Inspect the console or log sink for a structured JSON log entry naming the action
Verify the log entry includes a correlation ID or session ID field
